messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — ran into a broken internal link in /kb/runtime/batching.md that 404s in staging. link-checker flagged it in today's sweep. Anyone owns that page?
link-checker-bot: auto-scan: /kb/runtime/batching.md -> 404 on /images/kv_cache.png (200 checks failed)
Maria Gomez: @Alex can you paste the failing URL so I can triage locally?
Alex Chen: It's the image path: https://assets.internal.redwood/images/kv_cache.png returns 403 in staging. Also the anchor #batching-tips redirects to /runbook which seems wrong.
Samir Patel: I used to own batching.md. I can take a quick look this afternoon. If it's just an asset, rehost to CDN sounds easiest.
Jin Park: If rehosting, prefer s3://kb-static-prod + canonical /cdn/kb/ path. Quick local fix if you want to patch all refs: 
```
git checkout -b docs/kv-image-fix
rg "kv_cache.png" -n | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|/images/kv_cache.png|/cdn/kb/kv_cache.png|g' {}
git commit -am "docs: rehost kv_cache.png to cdn"
```
Nora (docs-bot): Suggested label: docs/ownership-needed. Add @Samir to CODEOWNERS if you're changing the doc.
Alex Chen: Samir, this would be great today if possible — it's blocking a customer demo tomorrow morning. If you can't, anyone else can do a tiny PR?
Samir Patel: I'll take it. If @Alex opens the PR I can land and update OWNERs.
Alex Chen: Opening now and assigning to Samir — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 (small sed + asset path change)
Maria Gomez: Quick question: should we also put a temporary 301 for the old /images/* path to avoid other breakages?
Jin Park: +1 for a short-lived redirect. Example nginx rule to add to static-config: 
```
location ~ ^/images/(.*)$ {
  return 301 /cdn/kb/$1;
}
```
Samir Patel: LGTM. I'll add a short note in the PR describing the revert window (one week) and update CODEOWNERS to include `@samir` for /kb/runtime/*.
Alex Chen: Thanks — assigning to @Samir. @link-checker-bot can you re-run the sweep after merge and ping this thread?
link-checker-bot: Re-scan queued; I'll post results in #docs after PR merge. :robot_face:
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: Good catch, Alex.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — I'll post demo status after merge.
